additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Parameters as an active infrastructure resource and normative-package entry. The current Parameters notes state that Bundle resource-uniqueness rules do not apply to Parameters unless the fullUrl extension is present on parameters with resources. The canonical parameters-fullUrl StructureDefinition is present in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/Parameters/StructureDefinition-parameters-fullUrl.xml with context Parameters.parameter. A 2025 implementers Zulip thread references the extension as available but does not establish a conflicting core rule.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit was made because the current build-scope Parameters narrative already links the external fullUrl extension in the relevant resource guidance, and duplicating that guidance in the Parameters.parameter.resource element comment would not change implementer understanding.
